title: SessionTasksChanged
description: The agent's task list changed: the whole list, as it is now, after a call of the main conversation that changed it ended well (plan 28, B-22). Read by the adapter of the engine from its own tools — a client draws it and never rebuilds it. A session event with its `seq`, so it is replayed; in the history (`transcript.appended`, `GET /transcripts/…/messages`) it follows the `tool.completed` of the call, by the same function as live. Only for an engine with the `taskList` capability.

tasks.description: Every task, in the agent's order. Empty when the agent cleared the list.

id.description: Opaque and stable for the life of the task — what a client keys a task by between two lists.

activeTitle.description: What the task is called while it runs ("Running the tests"). Absent when the agent gave none: the client shows the `title`.

at.description: When the call that changed the list was written, ISO 8601 — on the history only, like the `at` of the `tool.completed` it follows. Absent live, where the frame's `ts` is the clock.
